author: goldenwalrus909
body:
Here's me obsessing over my forums posts, again! xD
Anyways, I was just wondering where the box that told you your total number of posts was under "Your Profile" went. I know if was on the old forums, but it disappeared when we came to the new ones. I personally really liked it as it was a way to almost keep your progress and I felt quite productive to see I had a few hundred forums posts. It was also a great landmark for celebrations (Well, not really celebrations, just feeling accomplished when you get to your desired amount of posts xP). I would really like this mostly out of curiosity, to be honest, and I was just wanting to know if it will come back and if it is, when it is. I would really love to see that feature again :3

title: Total number of posts?

replies.author: Joao_Victor
replies.body: I think it's possible by going to old.avicus.net/Name and adding up your posts there and your posts on your profile here.

replies.author: goldenwalrus909
replies.body: Thanks, but I have no idea how many posts I've put on here. when I go to my chart for months, it's just a perfectly diagonal line with no points to tell me how many posts I've made that month. I might just be confused on the system of it, though, I still don't know entirely how it works. Say you post 20 posts in January, 20 posts in Feburary, and 10 in June. When you come to see how many posts you made in June, would the amount of posts be 50 because you add together all previous posts and the posts you made that month, or would it be only 10? If it's only 10, it would be really hard to see how many posts you made because there's no way to see how many posts you made the other months, so you can just do some simple addition. I know it's not a big deal, but m,y curiosity is really bugging me. Any help would be really appreciated (:
